parts.text:
方案一：快速对比流水线（推荐起步）
数据源：MMVP（含300张图 + Questions.csv 标注）

MMVP 专为探测模型是否真正“看见”了细节而设计。它的每一对图片在 CLIP 视觉空间中高度相似，但存在方向、朝向、开闭、计数等关键差异，正确答案恰好相反。如果你的一系列模型在配对准确率上普遍偏低，说明它们的视觉编码器存在系统性盲区。

执行工具：vlmeter

vlmeter 是一个“准确率 × 成本”流水线，核心能力正好匹配你的需求：一套数据同时评多个模型，自动出对比报告。它原生支持 classification 任务（选项匹配），MMVP 的 A/B 选择题可以直接转换为它的数据格式。

操作步骤：

第 1 步：下载 MMVP 数据
从 Hugging Face 获取数据集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/MMVP/MMVP。解压后你会看到 MMVP Images/（300张图）和 Questions.csv（包含 Index、Question、Options、Correct Answer 四列）。

第 2 步：转换为 vlmeter 的 JSONL 格式
vlmeter 的单题格式需要 id、image、question、options、answer 字段。用一段简单的 Python 脚本即可完成转换，核心逻辑是逐行读取 CSV，将每道题的 Correct Answer 映射到选项列表中的对应字母。关键在于保留 pair_id 信息：MMVP 的 300 道题按顺序每两题构成一对（第1&2题一对，第3&4题一对……），在 JSONL 中可以用 Index // 2 作为配对键，用于后续计算更严格的配对准确率。

第 3 步：用 vlmeter 批量运行你的模型
安装后，通过一条命令同时指定多个模型：

bash
python3 -m vlmeter run --models model-a,model-b,model-c --data mvp_eval.jsonl
vlmeter 支持 OpenAI 兼容接口、Anthropic、Google Gemini 以及 Ollama 本地模型，模型接入只需在 config/models.yaml 中加几行配置。

第 4 步：读取自动生成的对比报告
vlmeter 会在 results/ 下生成 Markdown 报告，总准确率、分任务准确率、错误样本明细并排列出，同时附有“成本与性能选型权衡表”。你可以直接用报告中的总准确率来横向排序你的一系列模型。

1: """Dataset loading and validation.
2: 
3: A dataset is a JSONL file (one item per line) or a CSV with the same columns:
4: 
5:   id          unique id (auto-generated from row index if missing)
6:   image       path to one image, relative to the dataset file
7:   images      OR a list of image paths (multi-image, e.g. 标准图 vs 现场图,
8:               cap 8); exactly one of image / images must be present
9:   task        "classification" | "vqa" | "checklist" (default: vqa)
10:   question    prompt shown to the model (not needed for checklist)
11:   choices     classification: option list, e.g. ["猫", "狗", "鸟"]
12:   answer      ground truth: option text or its letter (classification), or the
13:               reference answer text (vqa)
14:   category    optional, used for per-category breakdown in the report
15:   match       optional vqa scoring strategy: exact | contains | numeric | judge
16:   tolerance   optional numeric tolerance for match=numeric
17:   checks      checklist only: [{"name": "有自行车", "answer": true,
18:               "criteria": "可见完整的自行车或其主要部分，含部分遮挡",
19:               "bbox": [0.12, 0.30, 0.45, 0.80]}] — one image set, multiple
20:               yes/no scene checks answered in ONE call; name 短名用于报告，
21:               criteria 判定标准只进提示词（可选）；
22:               bbox 定位类（可选）：answer=false 时模型必须给出 bbox 证据才判对——
23:               值为 0-1 归一化 [x1,y1,x2,y2] 金标区域（IoU≥0.5 算命中），
24:               或 true（只要求给出合法 bbox，不比对区域）
25: """
26: from __future__ import annotations
27: 
28: import hashlib
29: import json
30: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
31: from pathlib import Path
32: 
33: VALID_TASKS = {"classification", "vqa", "checklist"}
34: VALID_MATCH = {"exact", "contains", "numeric", "judge"}
35: MAX_IMAGES = 8  # 多图上限：控制单次调用成本与各提供商的图片数限制
36: 
37: 
38: @dataclass
39: class Check:
40:     name: str      # 短名：用于报告列名与结果 ID
41:     answer: bool
42:     criteria: str = ""  # 判定标准：写进提示词，对齐模型与标注员的主观标准
43:     need_bbox: bool = False              # 定位类：判"否"必须给 bbox 证据
44:     gold_bbox: list[float] | None = None  # 金标区域 [x1,y1,x2,y2]（0-1 归一化）
45: 
46: 
47: @dataclass
48: class Item:
49:     id: str
50:     image: str | None = None
51:     images: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
52:     task: str = "vqa"
53:     question: str = ""
54:     choices: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
55:     answer: str = ""
56:     category: str = "未分类"
57:     match: str | None = None
58:     tolerance: float = 0.0
59:     checks: list[Check] = field(default_factory=list)
60: 
61:     @property
62:     def image_paths(self) -> list[str]:
63:         """本次调用的全部图片（单图字段归一成单元素列表）。"""
64:         if self.images:
65:             return self.images
66:         return [self.image] if self.image else []
67: 
68: 
69: def check_record_id(item_id: str, check_name: str) -> str:
70:     return f"{item_id}::{check_name}"
71: 
72: 
73: def item_record_ids(item: Item) -> list[str]:
74:     """Result-record ids an item expands to (checklist items yield one per check)."""
75:     if item.task == "checklist":
76:         return [check_record_id(item.id, c.name) for c in item.checks]
77:     return [item.id]
78: 
79: 
80: @dataclass
81: class Dataset:
82:     items: list[Item]
83:     path: Path
84:     fingerprint: str  # md5 of the raw file, used to key result caching
85: 
86:     def __len__(self) -> int:
87:         return len(self.items)
88: 
89:     @property
90:     def total_records(self) -> int:
91:         return sum(len(item_record_ids(it)) for it in self.items)
92: 
93: 
94: def load_dataset(path: str | Path) -> Dataset:
95:     p = Path(path).resolve()
96:     if not p.exists():
97:         raise FileNotFoundError(f"dataset not found: {p}")
98:     fingerprint = hashlib.md5(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
99: 
100:     rows: list[dict] = []
101:     if p.suffix.lower() == ".csv":
102:         import pandas as pd
103: 
104:         df = pd.read_csv(p, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
105:         for _, row in df.iterrows():
106:             rows.append(dict(row))
107:     else:
108:         for i, line in enumerate(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), 1):
109:             line = line.strip()
110:             if not line or line.startswith("#"):
111:                 continue
112:             try:
113:                 rows.append(json.loads(line))
114:             except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
115:                 raise ValueError(f"{p.name} line {i}: invalid JSON ({e})") from e
116: 
117:     items: list[Item] = []
118:     errors: list[str] = []
119:     for i, row in enumerate(rows):
120:         item, err = _build_item(row, i, p.parent)
121:         if err:
122:             errors.append(err)
123:         else:
124:             items.append(item)
125:     if errors:
126:         raise ValueError("dataset validation failed:\n  " + "\n  ".join(errors))
127:     if not items:
128:         raise ValueError(f"dataset {p.name} has no items")
129:     return Dataset(items=items, path=p, fingerprint=fingerprint)
130: 
131: 
132: def _resolve_image_paths(row: dict, where: str, base_dir: Path) -> tuple[list[str] | None, str | None]:
133:     """image（单图）或 images（多图）二选一，解析为绝对路径列表。"""
134:     single = str(row.get("image") or "").strip()
135:     multi_raw = row.get("images")
136:     if single and multi_raw:
137:         return None, f"{where}: image 与 images 只能用其一"
138:     raw_list: list[str] = []
139:     if single:
140:         raw_list = [single]
141:     elif multi_raw is not None:
142:         if not isinstance(multi_raw, list) or not multi_raw:
143:             return None, f"{where}: images 必须是非空路径列表"
144:         if len(multi_raw) > MAX_IMAGES:
145:             return None, f"{where}: images 超过上限 {MAX_IMAGES} 张"
146:         raw_list = [str(x).strip() for x in multi_raw]
147:         if not all(raw_list):
148:             return None, f"{where}: images 含空路径"
149:     else:
150:         return None, f"{where}: missing 'image'（或 'images'）"
151: 
152:     paths = []
153:     for raw in raw_list:
154:         ip = Path(raw)
155:         if not ip.is_absolute():
156:             ip = base_dir / ip
157:         ip = ip.resolve()
158:         if not ip.exists():
159:             return None, f"{where}: image not found: {ip}"
160:         paths.append(str(ip))
161:     return paths, None
162: 
163: 
164: def _parse_gold_bbox(v, where: str, j: int) -> tuple[bool, list[float] | None, str | None]:
165:     """check.bbox: true（只要证据）或 [x1,y1,x2,y2]（0-1 金标区域）；缺省 = 非定位项。"""
166:     if v is None:
167:         return False, None, None
168:     if isinstance(v, bool):
169:         return v, None, None
170:     if isinstance(v, list) and len(v) == 4:
171:         try:
172:             nums = [float(x) for x in v]

"""Convert MMVP Questions.csv + images into vlmeter JSONL (classification).

MMVP: 300 questions, each paired with one image; every two consecutive
questions (1&2, 3&4, ...) form a near-duplicate "trick" pair. We keep a
pair_id (Index // 2) so a stricter pair-accuracy can be computed later.

Output per item:
  id, image (absolute path), task=classification, question,
  choices=[A_text, B_text], answer (letter A/B), category, pair_id
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(r"C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\mmvp-bench")
CSV = BASE / "MMVP" / "Questions.csv"
IMG_DIR = BASE / "MMVP" / "MMVP Images"
OUT = BASE / "mmvp_eval.jsonl"

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv(CSV, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
print(f"CSV rows: {len(df)}  cols: {list(df.columns)}", flush=True)

# Map image number -> filename by extracting digits from each filename.
num_to_file: dict[int, str] = {}
for f in IMG_DIR.iterdir():
    if f.suffix.lower() in (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp"):
        digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", f.stem)
        if digits:
            num_to_file[int(digits)] = f.name
print(f"images found: {len(num_to_file)}", flush=True)

OPT_RE = re.compile(r"(?im)^\s*([A-H])[\.\)、]\s*(.*?)(?=^\s*[A-H][\.\)、]\s*|\Z)")
LETTERS = "ABCDEFGH"

def parse_options(raw: str) -> list[str]:
    parts = OPT_RE.findall(raw)
    if parts:
        # keep declared order (some options may be out of A..H order)
        ordered = sorted(parts, key=lambda p: LETTERS.index(p[0]) if p[0] in LETTERS else 99)
        # de-dup by letter, keep first
        seen = {}
        for letter, text in ordered:
            if letter not in seen:
